wminc-code-macrolanguage: Luuqadda [[wikipedia:$2 language|"$3"]] waa [[wikipedia:ISO 639 macrolanguage|luuqad weyne]], oo ka kooban luuqadaha xubnaha ah ee soo socda:
wminc-code-collective: Koodhka "$1" ma tilmaamayo luqad gaar ah, balse wuxuu tilmaamayaa urur luuqado ah, kuwaas oo ah [[wikipedia:$2 language|luuqadaha "$3"]].
wminc-code-retired: Koodhkan luuqadeed waa la beddelay, mana tilmaamayo luqaddii asalka ahayd mar dambe.
wminc-custom-editnotice-2: Si aad u muujiso luuqadaha aad awooddo inaad isticmaasho, fadlan isticmaal $1. Tusaale ahaan, haddii luqaddaada hooyo ay tahay Faransiis oo aad si fiican ugu hadli karto Ingiriisiga, isticmaal $2.
wminc-custom-featuredwikis-approved: Kuwani waa la ansixiyey iyo/ama la sameeyey:
wminc-custom-featuredwikis-active: Kuwani waa kuwo firfircoon waxaana laga yaabaa inay helaan boggooda gaarka ah dhowaan:
wminc-custom-featuredwikis-permanent: Kuwani waxay u badan tahay inay halkan sii joogaan:
wminc-custom-newarticletext-noprefix: Fadlan ogow: Waxaad samaynaysaa bog aan lahayn [[$1|horgale]]
wminc-custom-newarticletext-withprefix-3: Waxaad samaynaysaa bog cusub oo ([[$1|horgale leh]]) oo la yiraahdo "{{FULLPAGENAME}}".
wminc-custom-newarticletext-withprefix-4: Sidoo kale ku dar horgalayaal xiriiriyeyaashaada: [[Page title]] u beddel [[Wx/xx/Page title]] iyo {{Page title}} u beddel {{Wx/xx/Page title}}.
wminc-custom-newarticletext-withprefix-5: Si aad tan si otomaatig ah ugu samayso, waxaad isticmaali kartaa [[$1|qalabka Add Prefix]].
wminc-custom-tb-incorrect-title-title: Waxaad isku dayaysaa inaad samayso bog leh cinwaan khaldan.
wminc-custom-tb-incorrect-title-text:
Cinwaanka waxa ay u badan tahay inuu ka maqan yahay [[$1|horgale]] ama uu qaab kale u yahay qaab khaldan (xarfo waaweyn oo ku jira horgalaha, calaamad oo ku dhammaata iwm.).

Haddii aad halkan ka timid bog kale, fadlan ku noqo oo sax xiriirka, ka dibna samee bogga leh magaca saxda ah. Haddii aad isku dayayso inaad si toos ah u samayso bogga, fadlan samee bog leh magac sax ah.

Haddii si uun tani ay kaa hor istaagayso samaynta bog aad u malaynayso inuu leeyahay qaab cinwaan sax ah, fadlan [[$2|la socodsii maamulayaasha]].
wminc-custom-tb-invalid-code-title: Waxaad isku dayaysaa inaad samayso bog aan lahayn [[$1|koodh ISO 639-1 ama -3 ah oo sax ah]].
wminc-custom-tb-invalid-code-text:
Koodhkani ma aha mid sax ah ama kama tirsana luqad loo oggol yahay mashaariicda cusub ee Wikimedia.

Haddii aad halkan ka timid bog kale, fadlan ku noqo oo sax xiriirka, ka dibna samee bogga leh magaca saxda ah.

Haddii si uun tani ay kaa hor istaagayso samaynta bog aad u malaynayso inuu leeyahay koodh ISO 639-1 ama -3 oo sax ah ama uu ka tirsan yahay luqad la oggol yahay, fadlan [[$1|la socodsii maamulayaasha]].
wminc-custom-tb-space-colon: Sababo farsamo awgood, cinwaan ma bilaaban karo meel bannaan ama laba dhibcood.
gadget-addprefix: Ku dar horgale: Si otomaatig ah ayuu horgalayaal ugu daraa xiriiriyeyaasha marka bog la samaynayo.
wminc-gadget-addprefix-help: Uma baahnid inaad isticmaasho horgalaha marka aad wax ka tafatirayso boggan. Si otomaatig ah ayaa loogu dari doonaa marka aad daabacdo bogga.
gadget-interwiki: Interwiki: Waxay ku darsataa shaqo lagu daro laguna muujiyo xiriiriyeyaasha luqadaha dhexdooda ee ka imanaya Wikidata.
wminc-gadget-iw-dialog-text: Isticmaal foomkan si aad ugu darto xiriiriyeyaasha interwiki adoo adeegsanaya shay Wikidata ah. Kaliya ku dheji aqoonsiga shayga Wikidata ama URL-ka shayga ama maqaal jira oo luqad kale ku qoran sanduuqa hoose, dabadeedna guji "{{int:wminc-gadget-iw-dialog-publish}}".
wminc-gadget-iw-dialog-replace-text: Markaad gujiso "{{int:wminc-gadget-iw-dialog-publish}}", waxaad ku beddeli doontaa xiriiriyeyaashii interwiki ee hore ee boggan xiriiriyeyaal interwiki oo uu bixiyo Wikidata. Maqaalka loo adeegsan doono xulashada shayga Wikidata waa kan soo socda:
wminc-gadget-iw-dialog-replace-editinste: Haddii taasi aysan sax ahayn, fadlan tafatir bogga si aad gacanta ugu saxdo xiriiriyaha.
wminc-gadget-iw-error-invalid: Aqoonsiga Wikidata ee aad gelisay ama bogga lala xiriiriyey ma jiro, ama boggu kuma xirna Wikidata. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
wminc-gadget-iw-error-reload: Fadlan dib u soo rar bogga oo mar kale isku day.
tag-gadget-interwiki-description: Tafatirrada ku dara xiriiriyeyaasha interwiki iyagoo adeegsanaya qalabka Interwiki.
gadget-settestwikipreference: Waxay ku darsataa badhamada "Deji luqadda" iyo "U deji (mashruucan tijaabada ah) inuu noqdo mashruucaaga tijaabada" dhinaca liiska marka la eegayo tijaabada wikiyada.
wminc-gadget-twpref-setwiki: U deji $1 inuu noqdo mashruucaaga tijaabada
wminc-gadget-twpref-setwiki-tooltip: U deji $1 inuu noqdo mashruucaaga tijaabada, si bogagga cusub ee aad abuurto ay uga mid noqdaan mashruucan
wminc-infopage-title-status-approved: Kani waa tijaabo wiki ah oo la ansixiyey oo ku jirta Wikimedia Incubator.
wminc-infopage-title-status-default: Kani waa tijaabo wiki ah oo ku jirta Wikimedia Incubator.
wminc-infopage-title-status-imported: Kani waa tijaabo wiki ah oo la soo dejiyey oo ku jirta Wikimedia Incubator.
wminc-infopage-title-status-invalidcode: Tijaabadan wiki-ga ah waxay lahayd koodh luqadeed [[$1|ISO 639]] oo aan sax ahayn, sidaas darteed waa la tirtiray.
wminc-infopage-title-status-open: Kani waa tijaabo wiki furan oo ku jirta Wikimedia Incubator.
wminc-infopage-title-status-rejected: Tijaabadan wiki-ga ah waxaa diiday Guddiga Luuqadaha, waana la tirtiray.
wminc-infopage-title-status-tocreate: Tijaabadan wiki-ga ah weli lama bilaabin.
wminc-infopage-title-status-toimport: Kani waa tijaabo wiki ah oo ku jirta Wikimedia Incubator oo ku dhow in halkan lagu soo dejiyo.
wminc-infopage-text-approved-prelangcom: Mashruuca la codsaday waa la sameeyey. Ogow in codsigan la ansixiyey ka hor hirgelinta [[$3|siyaasadda soo jeedinta luqadaha ee la mideeyey]], sidaas darteed looma adeegsan karo tusaale ahaan codsiyada mustaqbalka (eeg sidoo kale [[$1|diiwaanka abuurista goobta]]).
wminc-infopage-text-approved: Tijaabadan wiki-ga ah waxaa ansixiyey [[$2|Guddiga Luuqadaha]] (eeg sidoo kale [[$1|diiwaanka abuurista goobta]]).
wminc-infopage-text-default: Halbeegga "$4" ayaa maqan ama khaldan. Ka eeg [[$5|halkan macluumaad dheeraad ah]] oo ku saabsan tusmada.
wminc-infopage-text-imported: Wiki-gan waa la [[$6|soo dejiyey]] ka dib markii wiki-ga la xiray. Haddii aad rabto inaad dib u bilowdo mashruucan, waxaad isticmaali kartaa bogaggan si aad uga bilowdo.
wminc-infopage-text-invalidcode: Tijaabadan wiki-ga ah waxay lahayd koodh luqadeed [[$7|ISO 639]] oo aan sax ahayn, sidaas darteed waa la tirtiray. Waxaa laga yaabaa inuu jiro fayl XML ah (weydii [[$8|maamulayaasha]]) oo loo wareejin karo wiki aan ahayn Wikimedia.
wminc-infopage-text-open: Tijaabadan wiki-ga ah waa furan tahay ama waxaa la xaqiijiyey inay u qalanto. Waxaa lagugu dhiirrigelinayaa inaad wax ku biiriso haddii aad taqaan luqaddan. Sidoo kale eeg [[$9|buugga wax ku biirinta]] si aad u ogaato waxa aad u baahan tahay inaad samayso.
wminc-infopage-text-rejected: Tijaabadan wiki-ga ah waxaa diiday [[$2|Guddiga Luqadaha]], waana la tirtiray. Waxaa laga yaabaa inuu jiro fayl XML ah (weydii [[$8|maamulayaasha]]) oo loo wareejin karo wiki aan ahayn Wikimedia.
wminc-infopage-text-tocreate: Tijaabadan wiki-ga ah weli lama bilaabin. Haddii aad taqaan luqaddan, raac tilmaamaha ku jira [[$9]]. Waxaad samayn kartaa Bogga Hore adigoo adeegsanaya ''"{{PAGENAME}}/Bogga Hore"'' oo "Bogga Hore" loogu turjumay luuqaddan (tusaale ahaan "Wp/fr/Accueil" haddii uu ahaan lahaa tijaabo wiki Faransiis ah).
wminc-infopage-text-toimport: Wiki-gan waa la xiray oo wuxuu ku dhow yahay in halkan lagu soo dejiyo. Haddii aad rabto inaad dib u bilowdo mashruucan, fadlan sug ilaa [[Special:ListUsers/import|soo dejiye]] uu marka hore ka soo dejiyo dhammaan bogagga wiki-gii asalka ahaa.
wminc-infopage-text-awaiting-creation: Waxa keliya ee uu sugayo waa in horumariyayaashu abuuraan, eeg '''[[phabricator:$1|hawsha $1]]'''.
wminc-infopage-language-macrolanguage: Xubin ka mid ah luuqad weynaha: $1
wminc-infopage-language-setlang-na: Luuqaddan hadda ma aha luqad isdhexgal oo la taageero.
wminc-infopage-content-all-pages: Dhammaan bogagga ku jira tijaabadan wiki-ga
wminc-infopage-req-meta-none: Ma jiro codsi ku jira [[$1|Meta-Wiki]] ([$2 abuur])
wminc-infopage-req-unprefixed-templates: Waxaa jira {{PLURAL:$1|$1 bog|$1 bogag}} isticmaalaya tusmo aan lahayn horgale
wminc-infopage-req-error-wikisource: Mashruucani waa '''Wikisource'''. Noocyada Wikisource waa in lagu sameeyaa [[$1|Wikisource Luuqadaha Badan]].
wminc-infopage-req-error-wikiversity: Mashruucani waa '''Wikiversity'''. Noocyada Wikiversity waa in lagu sameeyaa [[$1|Beta Wikiversity]].
